note:
What each gate in the census's `green-with-zero` bucket reads nothing over, and which of four causes it is.
The population is DERIVED, never listed: `node tools/audit-gate-inputs.mjs` takes every gate its reading puts in
`green-with-zero` and fails if one has no row here, and fails a row whose gate has left the bucket. A row is deleted
by fixing the gate or the reading - never by deleting the row to make the count smaller.

  empty-is-correct      zero members is the healthy reading, and the gate's green is right (`because` says why).
  reader-blind          a fact about the READING: it cannot see which members the gate judges. The fix is in
                        tools/audit-gate-inputs.mjs's read model, or in the shared reader the gate hands its root to.
  unmeasurable          the input is not in this tree (the operator's path, a built artifact, an installed game) or
                        the gate reads no file at all: nothing here can settle the empty case. `because` says what
                        would.
  unguarded-population  a fact about the GATE: the reading sees a population this tree owns and the gate has no
                        zero branch, so a filter that moved reads as a clean run. `guard` names the branch that
                        would settle it. This is debt with an owner, not an acceptance.
